title: Microsoft increases Windows 11 fees for OEMs
description: The crunch on the PC market continues as the rising memory chip prices are not the only thing that's getting more expensive. Starting today, Microsoft is hiking up its Windows 11 license fees for OEMs. The price increase is somewhere between 7% and 10%, which is unusually high. One of the PC vendors noted that it's expected for Microsoft to increase prices pretty much every year, but it's usually by a low singe-digit percentages. Big OEMs that sell PCs in large volumes like Dell, Asus, HP, etc. will see their fees increased by around 7%, but smaller manufacturers will probably have...

title: Sony Semiconductor and TSMC join forces to make next-gen imaging processors
description: Sony's chip-making arm, Sony Semiconductor Solutions, will enter into a joint venture with TSMC (Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company) that will manufacture image sensors for smartphones. Sony will be the sole controlling shareholder of the joint venture, which will aim to start volume production in 2029. The joint venture still needs to advance through several regulatory and financial steps. Sony will contribute 465 billion yen ($2.92b, €2.6b) in a combination of cash and assets, while TSMC will contribute 282 billion yen ($1.77b, €1.5b). The strategic partnership will see...

title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ and Tab S12 Ultra move a step closer to launch as they get Bluetooth certified
description: Last month, Samsung confirmed that the Galaxy Tab S12 series would be unveiled in H2 2026. Samsung didn't reveal the launch date of the Galaxy Tab S12 series, but the lineup has moved a step closer to launch as it got certified by Bluetooth SIG. The Galaxy Tab S12 series includes two tablets - the Galaxy Tab S12+ and the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. The Bluetooth SIG database lists five models of the Galaxy Tab S12+ and three models of the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra, along with their model numbers, and both tablets are expected to come in cellular and non-cellular versions. Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+...

title: Spotify starts labeling AI artists and removing them from recommendations
description: Today, Spotify has announced a new label for AI artists. It's called "AI Persona", and it's meant to signal to listeners that an artist's identity may be AI-generated and "does not represent a real person", the company says. This will begin appearing in mid-September. Interestingly, this will not only be applied to artist profiles that self-disclose as AI Personas, but Spotify will also add it to other "relevant profiles", because it's "focused on elevating music from authentic artists building careers in music". By default, anything created by these AI Personas will be excluded...

title: Google Pixel Tag is official with UWB support and one-year battery life
description: The recently leaked Pixel Tag is real, and it's now official. Google says it's a "finder tag", and like Apple's AirTag and Samsung's Galaxy Tag, it's meant to help you keep track of your belongings. The Pixel Tag uses Google's Find Hub network for tracking. It's made out of stainless steel designed to resist flexing and cracking, and it's IP67-rated for water and dust resistance. It supports Bluetooth with Bluetooth Channel Sounding, and UWB. It has a built-in speaker that can play a sound to help you find your Pixel Tag, and it also has a button which you can press to make your...

title: Here is how much the new Pixel 11 phones cost
description: Google unveiled the Pixel 11 series today – all but the 11a. There is a new vanilla model, a small and a large Pro model, plus a new Fold. The company is also launching a new smartwatch and its first smart tag too. The phones are currently on pre-order – see the table below for how much they cost. In short, they are $100 more expensive than their 2025 predecessors. The pre-order stage will last a couple of weeks as the first shipments are scheduled to go out on August 20. The Google Pixel 11 comes in four colors: Frost, Hibiscus, Pistachio and Obsidian. You can see them...

title: Google Pixel Watch 5 debuts with Gemini Intelligence, improved health tracking
description: Alongside the Pixel 11 series, Google also unveiled the Pixel Watch 5 at its Made by Google event. While it retains much of the design of its predecessor, the new smartwatch introduces improved health tracking features and comes with Gemini Intelligence built in. Like its predecessor, the Pixel Watch 5 is available in 41mm and 45mm sizes, with both Wi-Fi-only and LTE variants. It also retains the same round AMOLED display, which offers a peak brightness of up to 3,000 nits. Same as last year, the new smartwatch continues to be equipped with the Snapdragon Wear W5 Gen 2 chipset....

title: The Google Pixel 11 arrives with Tensor G6 and faster charging
description: The Google Pixel 11 continues to straddle the line between flagship and mid-ranger. It has the new Google-designed Tensor G6 – more on that in a second – which also powers the new Pro models. However, it has a more basic display and a triple camera with stripped-down hardware compared to said Pros. The Tensor G6 is the second generation Google chipset to come out of the TSMC fabs – specifically, this is the first smartphone chip to be built on TSMC’s 2nm node. Google focused on optimizing power usage, though it promises performance gains too. The Google Pixel 11 is powered by the...

title: Google unveils the Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL, the new Pixel 11 Pro Fold joins them
description: Notification LEDs went out of fashion and their functionality was replaced by always-on displays. But can this classic feature make a comeback with the power of AI? Google wants to find out. We are referring to the new HiLight feature that sits beside the rear camera lenses of the Pixel 11 trio. This activates when you put the phone face-down – it can notify you of an incoming call from a preferred contact and it also lights up when talking to Gemini. HiLight is a notification LED for the age of AI Speaking of Gemini, Google is launching a more capable version for phones (and...

title: Google Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold prices in India leak
description: Google is unveiling the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold in just a few hours. Ahead of that, a new rumor brings us the purported pricing for three of the devices in India. If you were expecting price hikes across the board, you were right. Google has already confirmed that price hikes for Pixels are coming, so this is not surprising at all. The Pixel 11 will allegedly start at INR 89,999 (approximately $943 at the current exchange rate), which is INR 10,000 ($104) more than the Pixel 10's starting price in India. The same INR 10,000 hike will apply to the...

title: Samsung releases a new ringtone based on Chopin’s Nocturne for One UI 9
description: Samsung has made it a tradition to release a new ringtone with every flagship launch. The Galaxy S series gets a new rendition of the company’s theme song, Over the Horizon. The version for the Galaxy S26 series is titled “A Soundtrack of the Earth” and was performed by the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra. Foldables get a piece of classical music instead – the Galaxy Z Fold7 and Z Flip7 actually got four based on Vivaldi’s The Four Seasons. For the Galaxy Z Fold8, Z Fold8 Ultra and Z Flip8, Samsung chose Frédéric Chopin’s “Nocturne in E-flat Major, Op. 9, No. 2.” This is a symbolic choice as...

title: Honor launches Robot Phone in China with 200MP titanium gimbal camera
description: The very first time we heard about the Honor Robot Phone was at the Magic8 series unveiling back in October of last year. Since then, we’ve seen countless leaks, teasers and we even got a sneak peek at an early prototype back at CES. Well, Honor finally took the wraps off the device today in China and we now have its full spec sheet as well as pricing and availability details. Honor Robot Phone The Robot Phone is a flagship Android smartphone with a gimbal camera attached to its back. The latter part is truly impressive, as Honor had to go through over 60 manufacturing processes...

title: Realme 16x arrives with the Dimensity 6300 SoC, a 144Hz screen, and a 7,000 mAh battery
description: Realme today unveiled the Realme 16x as the newest member of the Realme 16 series. One of the headline features of the Realme 16x is its 7,000 mAh battery with 45W charging support. It also supports all-scenario bypass charging and 6.5W wired reverse charging. Another headline feature of the Realme 16x is its 144Hz LCD, measuring 6.81" diagonally. It has a 1,570x720-pixel resolution, 1,200 nits peak brightness, and is protected by Panda-1681 glass. The Realme 16x is powered by the Dimensity 6300 SoC, paired with up to 6GB of LPDDR4X RAM. The smartphone has up to 256GB of onboard...

title: iOS 27 code confirms six upcoming iPhones
description: Yesterday, Apple released the fifth beta of iOS 27 for developers, and according to a new report, this version contains some hidden code that reveals six upcoming iPhone models. The references in question were found in the system files related to the battery drivers and the Battery Intelligence features. Alongside the existing models, the iOS 27 beta 5 code also mentions the iPhone Air 2 (codenamed V62), the iPhone 18 Pro (V63), the iPhone 18 Pro Max (V64), the iPhone 18 (V67), the iPhone Ultra (V68), and the iPhone 18e (V69). iPhone 17 Pro The codenames align with previous leaks...

title: Lenovo unveils its next gaming tablet's AnTuTu score while a rumor reveals its battery capacity
description: Lenovo is fully unveiling its next gaming tablet on August 25. Ahead of that, today the company has announced its AnTuTu score, and it's very impressive at 4,585,844. The tablet will be called Y700 Infinite, or Y700 Ultimate, or Y700 Unlimited - machine translation from Chinese isn't very accurate in this case. Either way, it seems to be based on the existing Y700, which launched back in March, but the new device will come with 5G mobile data connectivity built-in. It will also, according to a new rumor, cut down on the battery capacity - from 9,000 mAh on the Y700, to 7,500 mAh,...

title: Honor's 12,000 mAh battery is now reportedly in "trial production"
description: Honor has, in the past, been rumored to aim for an 11,000 mAh to 12,000 mAh battery for the upcoming Power3, but then it seemed like 10,000 mAh was all it would get. We also heard that the company was developing a 14,000 mAh smartphone battery, but right now it's unclear what happened to that. However, Digital Chat Station now claims that Honor is developing a new 12,000 mAh battery, which has already entered "trial production". 12,000 mAh, of course, is the typical capacity that will be advertised by the brand. The battery allegedly has a rated capacity of 11,790 mAh, and a rated energy...

title: Huawei Watch GT 7 and GT 7 Pro bring up to 21-day battery life
description: Huawei introduced the Watch GT 7 and Watch GT 7 Pro in China last week alongside the nova 16 SE, the 2026 MateBook Fold, and the 2026 MatePad Pro. The new smartwatches offer modest upgrades over the Watch GT 6 series and are available for purchase in China. The Watch GT 7 comes in 41mm and 46mm case sizes, while the Watch GT 7 Pro is available in a single size. When it comes to design, both smartwatches are similar to their predecessors. The 41mm Watch GT 7 features a 1.32-inch round AMOLED display, while the 46mm model and the Watch GT 7 Pro are equipped with a larger 1.47-inch...

title: Claude now watermarks text to indicate that it was generated by AI
description: You may have seen watermarks on AI-generated images to indicate that they were indeed made with AI. Now, even AI-generated text is being watermarked to make it easier for consumers to spot online content and comments that were written by AI. Anthropic, the company behind Claude, has signed the EU’s Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content and explains how text watermarking works. Text watermarks are machine-readable but should be transparent to humans. “When a supported Claude model generates text, it weaves an imperceptible watermark directly into the text itself. You...

title: vivo X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max design details, screen sizes, and SoC details leak
description: vivo is expected to launch the X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max next month, and today thanks to a new leak from Digital Chat Station on Weibo, we have some details about their screen sizes and design details, specifically for the camera bumps. Both Pro models will allegedly have big, centered circular camera islands, while the vanilla X500 will have a smaller circular camera protrusion on the top left corner of the rear panel. vivo X300 Pro The X500 Pro will apparently have a 6.37" display, while the Pro Max will have a 6.85" screen. Both of these phones will also have more rounded...

title: Redmi K100 Pro and K100 Pro Max announced
description: As expected, Xiaomi unveiled its newest Redmi K-series phones in China today, and they are equipped with some impressive specs. Though they look alike, they also bring several key differences. Redmi K100 Pro (left) and K100 Pro Max (right) Redmi K100 Pro gets Qualcomm’s recently announced Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V Series (SM8850-1-AB) chip, which is a binned version of the regular SD Elite Gen 5. The major change is on the GPU side, where the Adreno 840 GPU comes with two cores running at 1.2GHz instead of three units clocked at 1.3GHz. The K100 Pro Max comes with the...
